Welcome to the Grafana learning path that walks you through configuring a mute timing. A mute timing creates a recurring schedule that suppresses notifications during specific time windows, such as weekends or overnight hours. Unlike silences (which are one-time), mute timings repeat automatically.

## Here's what to expect

When you finish this path, you will be able to:

- Navigate to the mute timings configuration
- Create a mute timing with specific time intervals
- Attach the mute timing to a notification policy

## Before you begin

Make sure you have:

- A Grafana Cloud account with Editor or Admin permissions.
- At least one notification policy already configured (complete the **Notification routing** path first).
